p-drakes-9524756381909.d:
A tweed blazer is one of those things you don’t know you need until you have one. It has that knack of being both rugged and refined, the kind of jacket you end up reaching for more than you ever expected.
Cut in Drake’s signature silhouette, it features a natural shoulder, subtle waist shaping, and a light construction that allows the jacket to move gracefully with the wearer.
Expertly tailored and fully canvassed with a hand-shaped chest, the jacket drapes naturally over the body, offering both shape and comfort. Hand-attached collars and sleeves provide a flexibility unmatched by machine construction, allowing the jacket to adapt seamlessly to the wearer, while a buggy lining ensures fluidity across the back and shoulders, and traditional lapels, with a wider profile and richer belly, reflect our time-honed house style.
Cut from 13.8oz Harris Tweed, woven by hand in the Outer Hebrides at one of the islands’ legendary mills, long regarded as the benchmark for authentic tweed.

p-drakes-9524756938965.d:
Straddling the half-world between super sharp and slouchy, our Games blazers are cut with ease to make sure they sit at the more relaxed end of the formal spectrum, and as such are cut slightly shorter and fuller in their silhouette than our traditional tailored jackets.
Our signature Mk. I Games Blazer draws inspiration from workwear as much as tailoring; a casual 3-roll-2 button jacket with a boxy silhouette, two patch and flap hip pockets with a patch chest pocket, a generous sleeve and unstructured body shape.
Twin needle seams and an unlined construction bring to mind the uniforms of artists and artisans of the 20th century, while nailing the need for crisp clean tailoring in our busy, modern world.
Cut from a 11.6oz heavy cotton twill woven in Yorkshire, pair it with the matching trousers for an informal take on the classic two-piece suit.

• Horn Buttons

Inspired by the crisp utility of traditional naval uniform, the Naval Pant reinterprets service dress through a distinctly Drake’s lens.
Cut from a Japanese military cotton satin, woven in faithful reproduction of the cloth once used for service dress, the fabric has a compact, faintly lustrous handle that feels smarter than your average fatigue. Finished in natural ecru, the undyed cotton recalls the earliest, no-nonsense uniforms, before khaki and camouflage.
Bar-tacked back pockets stand up to hard wear, while our signature slanted front patch pockets lend both ease and a distinctive line. The silhouette is clean and straight, but not parade-ground stiff. Brass hardware adds a touch of salty bravado, set against tonal stitching and crisp finishing that keeps things from drifting too far into costume.
